items.w: ביהוה חסיתי איך תאמרו לנפשי נודי הרכם צפור
items.title: COURAGE
items.quote: I have taken my refuge in Hashem. How dare you say to me, flee from your mountain like a bird?
items.text: If you trust in Hashem’s protection, you can confidently challenge anyone who seeks to weaken your relationship with Him.

items.w: כי הנה הרשעים ידרכון קשת כוננו חצם על יתר לירות במו אפל לישרי לב
items.title: METHODICAL PROCEDURES
items.quote: For behold, the wicked stretch the bow, ready their arrow on the bowstring to shoot in the dark at the upright of heart.
items.text: Don’t get caught up in the mechanics of preparation while ignoring the ultimate result of your activities.

items.w: כי השתות יהרסון צדיק מה פעל
items.title: HASHEM IS RIGHTEOUS
items.quote: When the foundations of the world are destroyed, what has [Hashem] the tzadik done?
items.text: Don’t let yourself be demoralized by tragedy. Hashem is righteous and always acts with righteousness, even though His purpose may not yet be clear to us. To be righteous means to do what is “right.”

items.w: עיניו יחזו עפעפיו יבחנו בני אדם
items.title: THE OMNISCIENT ONE
items.quote: His eyes observe. His eyelids [are open to] scrutinize mankind.
items.text: Hashem sees all, and there is no evil that escapes Him.

items.title: THE TEST
items.text: The success of the wicked is an exercise in the emunah of the tzadik. Ultimately, the tzadik is strengthened by it.

items.title: JUSTICE
items.quote: He will rain down fiery coals upon the resha’im.
items.text: Ultimately, the resha’im must pay for their crimes, unless they have repented.

items.title: HEAVENLY REWARD
items.quote: He loves righteousness, for the upright to see His presence.
items.text: Because Hashem is righteous He continues to purify those who are upright until they merit to see His presence.
